description.value: Spicy Pro Hot Pot is a hot pot restaurant located in Richmond, BC, a city known for its diverse and high-quality Asian dining scene. Hot pot dining is a communal, table-cooked experience where diners simmer fresh ingredients in a shared broth — a filling option for cyclists refuelling after a ride. The restaurant is located in a multi-unit commercial address on Capstan Way.
